title: Cohomological boundedness of the localizing exceptional object
statement: Fix a universe u, a prime \ell, a field k of characteristic different from \ell, separated finite-type schemes Z and Y over k, a proper morphism g : Z -> Y, and an admissible ell-adic coefficient Lambda, as in [lem-sfb-adic-localizing-exceptional-constructible]. For every supplied adjunction adj : ellAdicLocalizingLowerStar Lambda ell g hLambda \dashv G and every K in the bounded constructible subcategory of Y, there exist integers a and b such that the homology objects of the underlying object G(K) vanish for every degree i with i < a or b < i.

lean.statement: theorem ellAdic_localizing_rightAdjoint_obj_isBounded (G : (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Y.left).FullSubcategory ⥤ (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Z.left).FullSubcategory) (adj : ellAdicLocalizingLowerStar Λ ℓ g hΛ ⊣ G) (K : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ Y.left)).FullSubcategory) : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, (i < a ∨ b < i) → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj ((G.obj ((boundedConstructibleToLocalizing Λ Y.left).obj K)).obj))

proof.text: The finite affine factorization and the rational or integral restriction construction give a common finite cohomological interval for the supplied right adjoint.
